description.text:
30th Celebration (30周年庆典) is the booster made for the Pokémon Trading Card Game's 30th anniversary, released on 16 September 2026. It came out worldwide on the same day, outside a few regions, the first time a Pokémon card product had done so. Every card is a holo, six to a pack.

It introduced the Futuristic Rare (FUR): Mew ex and Mewtwo ex drawn by the graphic artist YOSHIROTTEN in vivid patterns meant to call up hope for an unknown future. Mew ex's Ability lets it use any attack of its player's Benched Pokémon, and Mewtwo ex's attack does 50 damage to each of the opponent's Pokémon ex. For the 30 years there are 30 Pikachu holos by 30 different illustrators, and every pack holds one of them. Many cards show Pokémon going about their day at different times, and 30 cards that stand for the game's history return in a special style, from the Charizard of the very first series to Pikachu & Zekrom-GX of Sun & Moon; they can be played wherever the original card can.

Many boxes came with it the same day: the 30th Celebration Futuristic Commemorative Box (幻彩未来纪念礼盒) with two FUR-style Pikachu ex holos and battle accessories designed by YOSHIROTTEN; the Deluxe Deck Sets of Espeon ex and Umbreon ex, each with two packs; a display box with day and night Espeon ex and Umbreon ex holos and 15 packs; card display sets with a new Greninja ex or Sylveon ex and three packs; and a coin set with two Pikachu coins from 30 designs and three packs. Its main cards are numbered out of 103, with the 30 Pikachu at 017 to 046, each also marked 01/30 to 30/30. Art Rare, Special Art Rare and FUR cards follow, then the 30 history cards at 136 to 165; three Mew cards are marked R, G and B, and the basic Energy print a type code.
